  WHY: A caller setting `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false` can still have a review dispatched with workflow edits enabled.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: The check fails closed with an error, and the review considers the diagnostic phrasing acceptable.
